title: Controlling Envy Toward a Coworker
paragraphs: Ketika rekan kerja Rafi dipromosikan ke posisi yang diam-diam ia harapkan untuk dirinya sendiri, ia merasakan sengatan iri hati tajam yang mengejutkannya karena betapa kuatnya perasaan itu. Selama sehari atau dua hari, ia sedikit menghindari rekan kerjanya, sadar bahwa perasaannya tidak adil tapi tidak yakin bagaimana menghilangkannya sepenuhnya sendirian.

Merenung dengan tenang suatu malam, Rafi mengingatkan dirinya bahwa rekan kerjanya bekerja keras dan pantas mendapatkan peran itu, dan bahwa iri hatinya sendiri lebih mencerminkan rasa tidak amannya daripada ketidakadilan yang sebenarnya terjadi. Minggu berikutnya, Rafi berusaha mengucapkan selamat dengan sepenuh hati kepada rekan kerjanya dan menawarkan bantuan tulus selama masa transisi, dan mendapati bahwa bersikap baik perlahan melunakkan iri hati yang selama ini ia pendam.
answerKey: When Rafi's coworker gets promoted to a position he had quietly hoped for himself, he feels a sharp sting of envy that surprises him with how strong it is. For a day or two, he avoids his coworker slightly, aware that his feelings are unfair but unsure how to shake them off completely on his own. Reflecting quietly one evening, Rafi reminds himself that his coworker worked hard and deserved the role, and that his own envy says more about his insecurity than about any unfairness that actually occurred. The following week, Rafi makes an effort to congratulate his coworker properly and offer genuine help during the transition, finding that acting kindly slowly softened the envy he had been carrying.
